text:
Situation: Cisplatin is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 16.1 days on hand for the 50 mg/50 mL presentation and 18.7 days for the 1 mg/mL presentation. Corvale General holds 30.9 days for the 50 mg/50 mL presentation and 31 days for the 1 mg/mL presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's history shows a cisplatin shortage first posted on 2023-02-10 and since resolved. FDA inspection 1207607 at Thymoorgan Pharmazie Gmbh ended 2022-10-06 and was classified VAI, 127 days before the shortage posting. FDA inspection 1203954 at the same plant ended 2023-04-25 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2023-07-10, 74 days after the shortage posting. The plant manufactures a Hikma-labeled cisplatin product (NDC 00143950401).

Our position: Current inventory is adequate but below preferred safety stock at Corvale East. No active FDA shortage exists. Proactive purchasing from a supplier not on the shortage list with an acceptable inspection history will maintain supply continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC for both presentations; buyer approves.
2. Buyer confirms delivery schedule and updates inventory projections; buyer approves.
3. Pharmacy director reviews receipt and allocation plan; pharmacy director approves.
4. P&T committee acknowledges the purchasing plan at next meeting; P&T committee approves.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or allocation restrictions at this time.
